Accepted package contents
- Native:28 plugins, exactly59 fleet skills plus6 runtime system skills,20 hooks. Includes repo-summaries. Excludes the unsupported Claude Rust LSP declaration. Claudish keeps its explicit rewrite workflow; display-only assistant transformation is not established.
- Claude:24 selected original identities in11 complete original marketplaces,25 catalog entries including the disabled/unselected cli-demo. Stage-only versions are original+codex.1. Original metadata, remote entries, dependencies and unselected local roots remain present. Official, revdiff, gvzdv-plugins and cc-transcript registrations remain unchanged; this does not replace the official marketplace with a narrow catalog.
- Source-owned tools/codex_package.py performs both builds with required candidate binary overrides and complete --marketplace inputs. The source builder, roster, every package input and exact artifacts are frozen under package-inputs with2417 file hashes. recipes/rebuild_packages.py reproduced every native and Claude payload byte, symlink and mode. Provenance source paths differ during replay because the sources are frozen inside the stage; original assembly argv/repo HEAD/diff/untracked hashes are retained.
- native/stage-evidence.json, native/provenance.json and claude/{provenance,assembly}.json contain the original provenance. final-stage.json seals the final payload, frozen inputs, evidence, recipes and derived Python environment, excluding mutable Python bytecode caches. Keep candidate-3 at its exact path because Python entrypoints have absolute shebangs.

Actual isolated ingestion evidence
- Native probe: /tmp/codex-port-candidate-3-native-probe, copied results under candidate-3/evidence/native-probe. Actual Codex0.155.1, accepted broker, custom CODEX_HOME=home/accounts/native, temporary git workspace and DAEMONKIT_HOME.28 supported CLI installs succeeded; per-plugin skill/hook matrix has no mismatch and no skill parsing errors. All20 hooks remained untrusted.
- All5 local MCP servers connected. Actual ccx workspace-relative sentinel read, cc-notes task_list, cco backends_list and capt-hook register_transcript succeeded. Direct cc-review get_review_files and ccx-reflected equivalent reached the isolated candidate daemon and returned the expected no-review domain error. This proves transport/schema/binding/home selection, not retrieval of populated review data.
- Process executable-path evidence confirms staged ccx, cc-notes, cc-review and cco. Capt-hook registration appeared only under the custom account tree. All recorded final-probe server/MCP PIDs are now absent; the probe stopped its explicit foreground daemon and owned broker/upstream processes. No live daemon was replaced.
- Claude probe: /tmp/codex-port-candidate-3-claude-probe/results.json, copied under evidence/claude-probe.36 supported CLI calls succeeded:11 marketplace registrations,24 selected installations and the final list. This is manifest pickup and installation, not a claim that every Claude model workflow ran.
- installed-artifact-audit.json compares19 installed native/Claude binary copies. Every actual hash equals its accepted candidate and every copy is a regular file. Ten explicit artifact overrides replace release bootstrap links with Mach-O executables. Slop-cop reuse is source-verified: its installed0.1.70 build differs from the frozen source only in release/plugin metadata, with no Go/go.mod/go.sum delta.
- Only Captain Hook retains binary symlinks, bin/capt-hook and bin/hook, into its source-owned launcher scripts. In a fresh isolated home containing only the candidate Info.plist, the Python launcher installed capt-hook12.51.0+codex.5 and transcript14.19.0+codex.6 with local wheel constraints and passed --help. The first --version probe failed because the CLI has no such option; its error is preserved. No helper executable was copied or run by that probe. The signed-app launcher remains conditional on the matching signed app; an old live app would select an old generation.

Accepted upstream gates and their limits
- Final core owner: make -j3 HELPER_VERSION=12.51.0+codex.5 passed4661 Python tests, Go race suites and27 Swift tests. Exact installed-wheel/daemonkit artifact.Store proofs passed, including protocol2. Transcript independent core419/minimal320/Swift bridge4 passed; owner/reviewer additionally report Python2853, CLI15 and Swift11. Downstream exact-wheel replay passed ccx693, cc-notes219+13 plus helper cases, and273 monorepo inline cases across6 host methods. Evidence: codex-port-final-build.txt and its referenced logs; this lane did not rerun those full suites.
- Final consumer race/vet/build passed with identical before/after source fingerprints. Three accepted binaries remain from that build. Codex-ask was superseded by the exact owner artifactce2e25b after the missing-native-generation correction; it was adopted without another rebuild. Broker's final delta only admits0.156.1 alongside0.155.1, and none of the four consumers calls EnsureServer, so the coordinator accepted no further rebuild.
- Independent native-owner review passed exact codex-askce2e25b and brokera92992 on the actual0.156.1 terminal. Native tool shell naturally lacked CC_INTERACT_GENERATION. The current canonical registry binding resolved and the intentional empty-question error occurred before any worker/scratch directory was created. Explicit malformed/stale/future generations still fail. Native/present/board examples now match this contract.
- Exact final cc-present384ebe passed a real HTTP interaction/SSE/native feedback test: idle input started a turn, active input arrived in that turn, both appeared once and were acknowledged. That proof used prior reviewed brokerdddcfb; finala92992 changes only runtime admission. Isolation/reattach/restart coverage remains the earlier report at its earlier present binary, not a repeated final-artifact claim.
- ccx final review accepted the native scope limitation and nine visible diagnostics:2 contextcheck and7 gosec. No lint-clean claim. The custom roots-capability client issue has no supported native Codex trigger under the observed one-MCP-process/cwd behavior without roots capability or a ccx_exec repo override.
- Monorepo guarded rollout manifest SHA256:9447b31ad4964fa8bcc0b7d0a94db05b8b5ffccfd907d37a1a1b99f62649fe0d. All22 write-source hashes match the candidate. It includes the stable authored-hook state-key expectation and board example correction. No live target change was made.

Source changes owned by this lane under explicit coordinator authorization
- cc-skills tools/codex_package.py and tools/test_codex_package.py: required executable overlays before writes, full Claude catalogs and candidate versions, and native prose that may document Claude variables.14 packaging tests pass. codex/README.md documents the supported commands and version semantics.
- captain-hook scripts/package-codex.py and tests/test_codex_packaging.py generate native frontmatter from shared source with preserved bodies/resource closure; captain_hook/.mcp.codex.json uses bare capt-hook, explicit --host codex and CODEX_HOME forwarding. Shared authoring-hooks skill and its API reference document host directories and pre/post-tool image semantics. Focused packaging/skill tests passed.
- cc-context scripts/package-codex.py and scripts/test_package_codex.py add optional DAEMONKIT_HOME forwarding so reflected calls reach the isolated candidate daemon; focused package test passed. Runtime/policy fixes and source rebuild belong to their owners.
- cc-skills plugins/codex/codex/skills/codex/SKILL.md, cc-present plugin/codex-skills/present/SKILL.md, and candidate monorepo .agents/skills/standup-updates/references/board.md align examples with current binding lookup and optional explicit generation fencing. Go owner-resolution code belongs to its source owner.
- Final ccx structural diff and git diff --check completed for all owned paths. slop-cop check --lang=markdown --llm-effort=off ran on every changed Markdown file; command exits are0, but existing prose diagnostics are retained and recorded in evidence/codex-port-final-source-checks.json. Present skill is clean; no blanket prose-clean claim. No added narration code comments were found. Prior uncommitted implementation remains intact; nothing was committed.

Reproduction and coordinator-only rollout
  fleet=/Users/yasyf/Code/codex-port-staging/candidate-3
  python3 "$fleet/recipes/verify_stage.py" "$fleet"
  python3 "$fleet/recipes/rebuild_packages.py" /tmp/codex-port-rollout-replay
The replay destination must be absent. This was independently run at /tmp/codex-port-final-replay-1 and passed. Source build, ingestion, audit and fake-home rollback recipes are retained under recipes; original source artifact build commands remain in the owner reports.

Exact install, backup and rollback commands: /tmp/codex-port-rollout-commands.txt and candidate-3/recipes/rollout-commands.txt.
They include signed-helper build/assertion/package-install with local wheel constraints; exact CLI link preflight; supported28 native and24 Claude installs; full private source/payload/state backups; --keep-data uninstall and exact prior Claude payload restoration; original Git/GitHub catalog re-registration; and exact CLI file/link/absence rollback. The snapshot/link scripts passed a fake-home test for payload/catalog restoration, mode preservation and drift refusal before writes. Plugin command plans use observed supported CLI semantics; end-to-end live rollback was not executed. Custom account/state homes and partial-install reconciliation remain coordinator responsibilities.

Unresolved rollout gates
1. No valid signing identity is available. Only the unsigned matching helper exists. Obtain and verify the matching Developer ID signed build, record its changed signed hashes, then authorize package-install/activation. Do not infer signed-helper readiness from Python MCP success.
2. Runtime/application choice and live GUI integration are unresolved. Installed CLI0.155.1 lacks desktop workspaceRouting; isolated official0.156.1 passed desktop/selector evidence, but no global runtime/app switch occurred. Verify PATH and wheel constraints in actual CLI/desktop/Orca children before activation; shell PATH alone is insufficient.
3. Native hook trust and actual trusted-hook execution, live daemon/schema transition, three-surface smoke, graphical notifications and client restarts remain coordinator gates. Source-ready is not live rollout acceptance.
4. Datadog returned HTTP401 without credentials. Authenticated Datadog and paid/external workflows were not exercised. No review-data retrieval, broad model workflow coverage or final-artifact replay of every earlier lifecycle test is claimed.

All accepted pins above supersede earlier speculative artifacts. capt-hook codex.3/.4, earlier codex-ask8eb806, candidate-1/2 and speculative-* remain historical evidence and are not selected for rollout.
